experiment: Candidate projection sensitivity and identifiability; not accuracy or true error.

parameters.perturbation_definition: 16 evenly spaced directions at exact radius, plus unchanged point; perturb two consecutive frame endpoints independently for speed envelopes.
parameters.time_step: Decoded source PTS; only consecutive frames and same temporary T ID / point type.
parameters.stale_H: First valid reference frame matrix held fixed at all later valid frames.
parameters.units: Candidate metres and metres/second under an unvalidated NBA-template homography.
parameters.feet_policy: Keep left and right separate; contact unknown; no averaging into a claimed ground point.
parameters.identity_policy: Temporary T IDs, no verified continuity. Speeds are numerical proxies.

geometry_contract.assumption: Candidates adopted only in an independent blank in-memory session; no browser draft or source file is changed. This simulates candidate preview, not human confirmation or accuracy validation.

speed_window_comparison.denominator: All observed E-BARD player-box endpoint (frame,T-ID) rows at frame>=lag, before requiring full-window T continuity and H availability.
speed_window_comparison.velocity_definition: Euclidean distance between endpoint projections divided by elapsed source PTS; not path length or validated player speed.
speed_window_comparison.continuity_gate: Same temporary T ID labelled player in every one of lag+1 frames, and accepted-in-memory H in every frame; do not bridge internal gaps.
speed_window_comparison.causal_timing: A trailing estimate needs no future frames after its endpoint, but needs lag frames of history before its first output. An estimate assigned to the start must wait until the end.
speed_window_comparison.identity_limit: Unbroken temporary T ID does not establish that the same real player occupies the full window; within-window switches are unknown.

reflection_example.interpretation: A global left/right reflection preserves Euclidean distances and scalar speeds while swapping basket-side labels and x direction; this cannot verify real side or identity.
